column1: # The lines of a server, as every program takes them: syn-mirror-server.pl and .ps1, rdp-host --meet ( RemoteDesk ), a DeFreez host
# ( Me.Mirror.meet ). A copy of this file lies in each of them; their tests read it. One line a case: the line, a tab, what it is -
# the password or the key, @ ( a port given at each start ) or = ( a fixed port ), and where: <point>:<port> or, the address read,
# <read key>@<keeper>:<port>[,...] - the ports put in where the line has none; or `error`.
# A password, a key, a read key: 16 letters and digits. A point, a keeper: a name or an IPv4 address, none of : @ = , or a space in
# it. A port: 1…65535; none after a point of @ or a keeper - 40000, the first port SYN Mirror installs; a fixed port names its own.
# Spaces around the line and around each read go.
